blocks.html: The VNS plug-in snaps your routes to real roads and gives you turn-by-turn audio and visual cues, plus on-the-fly re-routing if you go off track.

slides.title: Open the Routes tool
slides.html: Open the Routes tool and select the + button to start a new route. With VNS loaded, the Route Planning dialog opens instead of the plain marker dialog.

slides.title: Enter addresses and pick a routing method
slides.html:
Fill in the start, one or more waypoint and destination fields.

  • Pick Google Routing, Offline Routing or Private Routing Server, tick any Avoid Ferries / Highways / Tolls boxes, then select Create.

slides.title: Set each address by hand
slides.html: Select the Menu button beside any address field to choose how to set it: enter via GoTo, map select, clear the field, or pick a recent address.

slides.title: Route around regions
slides.html: For offline routing, tick Route around geofences? to avoid all geofences, or tick Route around regions in region manager? and select Open Route Around Region Manager.

slides.title: Manage the avoidance shapes
slides.html: Pick existing shapes to route around, add new ones with the + button, or remove a shape with its trash icon. Select Done when finished.

slides.title: Name, set checkpoints and cues
slides.html: In the route details you can rename the route, set the Route Details type (infil/exfil, primary/secondary), name checkpoints, set a Navigation Cue per checkpoint, and VNS Recalculate the whole route or a single segment. Select GO to start navigating.

slides.title: VNS-recalculate a manual route
slides.html: To convert a hand-drawn route, open its details, set it as a driving route in the Route Details Dropdown, then select VNS Recalculate at the top right for the full route, or on a checkpoint row for just that segment.

slides.title: Re-route and Quick Nav safe points
slides.html: During navigation the Re-routing icon turns its border green when enabled, so ATAK recalculates if you go off route. Predefine safe points under Additional Tools > VNS > Set Quick Nav Points, name them with Add new Quick Nav point, then tap Quick Nav in navigation to route to one.

slides.title: Download offline routing data
slides.html: Offline routing and re-routing need a local data set. Go to Additional Tools > VNS > Manage Offline Areas, then select Download to pull a data set onto the device or Delete to remove one.
